record 68: Ch06 rebuilt twice - the prophecy, the missing breakthrough, the SL1-only canon check

Three strikes from the author on one chapter, all correct.

v1 put a prophecy about his granddaughter's ring in Qian Daoliu's mouth, sourced
it to a book he would never need, and said the family's gold ring had left this
earth when the seat only sits vacant in the God Realm. Gold is the Angel God's
tenth ring, it arrives only with the god seat, and the seat passes by blood and
not by selection.

v2 fixed the line and then shipped a chapter in which a man who had swallowed two
supreme immortal herbs, forged the fire-and-ice body and re-knit two rings into
blood-essence gold gained no rank, used no herb on himself and changed no skill.
Root cause: I read F15's 'no free rank' as 'no rank'. Canon is the opposite -
immortal herbs are what breaks a bottleneck.

And the canon check was four searches of Soul Land 1 for a mechanic that does not
exist in Soul Land 1. The blood-essence ring is an SL3 concept.

v3 carries all of it: ninety-seven on the page, the chrysanthemum pill swallowed,
the crooked meridian torn open by the medicine, both skills replaced by blood
skills, the body remade, and the limitation that the blessing cannot straighten
the meridian. 3,399w, PASS.

closed_prs.title: Open seed_of_creation: an SL2.5-era serial (foundation only, no chapters)
closed_prs.body:
## What this is

A new Soul Land project, scaffolded to the kit and **deliberately not drafted**.

Era: **Soul Land 2.5** — *Legend of the Divine Realm* — running into the ten-thousand-year gap on Douluo before SL3. Protagonist: the son of the God of Destruction (Hui Mie) and the Goddess of Life (Sheng Ming), a god from birth, sealed, holding Divine Adaptation Talent, fallen to Douluo in the same event-window canon sends the infant Tang Wulin down.

18 files, 2,897 insertions, **zero deletions**. `README.md` and `STATE.md` gain additive index entries only.

## Why there is no chapter one

`SOUL_LAND_UNIVERSAL_KIT/00_START_HERE.md` and `02_PROJECT_SETUP.md` both say the spine lock must be filled before drafting — Lock 4 left empty is what cost `blue_silver/` a 90,000-word rebuild. So chapter one is **blocked on four user rulings**, written out with their costs in `foundation/OPEN_DECISIONS.md`:

| Blocker | What is on offer |
|---|---|
| **Spine** (Lock 4) | Three candidates, each a full "___ wants ___ from my protagonist, and will ___ to get it" sentence, each with its cost. None chosen on the author's behalf |
| **Name** (Lock 6) | Five pinyin candidates |
| **Landing place** | Five options costed |
| **Ring mechanism** | Four canon roads, all receipted — Lock 7 forbids killing for rings |

## What the research turned up

`foundation/CANON_NOTES.md` carries 43 tagged claims with sources and check dates. Three findings changed the project:

- **Two premise collisions with hard canon, recorded rather than smoothed over.** Canon states in Hui Mie's *own quoted words* (SL2.5 ch. 3) that he and Sheng Ming cannot have a child — so the story is built on that contradiction instead of around it, logged as a user ruling over canon with the cost written down. And "twenty years old at the ascension" is impossible on a single clock, so it is read on the clock canon supplies: one divine day = one Douluo year, giving **twenty divine years and twenty Douluo days**, both true, neither ever stated without its clock.
- **One wrong scoping assumption, caught before it reached a scene.** The era is *not* godless. Tang Hao is Plane Master of the Douluo Star and A Yin is the plane's Life Core, both second-level deities, both present for the entire span. This generated a new firewall (Tang Hao may register and watch; he may not identify or report) and revised the recommended spine.
- **Seven single-source rows** are named in `CANON_NOTES.md` §6 and barred from carrying plot until a second receipt exists.

## Honest notes, in the files rather than buried

- The DC anchor (~12,650) is **derived arithmetic with a ±25-year margin**, not a canon date. No source dates SL2 in DC. It is listed in `STATUS_PANEL.md` FORBIDDEN FIGURES so nobody treats it as precise.
- The setup is **30,809 words** against the kit's own ~2,000-word guidance, which calls anything more "procrastination with a file extension." Recorded in `HANDOFF.md` §7 with a defence, a partial concession, and a commitment that the apparatus is **frozen through Book One**.
- The kit's `01_CANON_SPINE.md` is SL1-weighted and does not describe this era. `codex/PLACES.md` opens with that warning so nobody writes Spirit Hall into a Federation.
- All 14 new files pass the Language Law: zero CJK, zero literal backslash-n, zero placeholder text.

## Verification

```
python3 SOUL_LAND_UNIVERSAL_KIT/tools/selftest.py
# → SELFTEST PASSED — all defects caught, clean chapter passes.
```

`verify.py` is **not** run — `chapters/` is empty by design. It gets run on chapter one before chapter one is called done.

## Relationship to existing work

- `blue_silver/` is **not superseded, paused or redirected**. `STATE.md` says so explicitly, and repo rule 1 (the author's word outranks any file on disk) is restated in the new entry.
- `blue_silver/ADAPTATION_TALENT.md` — the locked universal Master Foundation v2.0 — is **not amended**. This project adds a module *beneath* it at `bible/ADAPTATION_TALENT_MODULE.md`, per the core's own §76.
- Nothing from `blue_silver/` is treated as canon here. A thematic resonance with A Yin is noted in `codex/CHARACTERS.md` and explicitly confined to craft.
- `reference/sl3_lin_hao/` untouched; still forbidden per `STATE.md`.

## Next step after merge

Read `seed_of_creation/HANDOFF.md`, then `foundation/OPEN_DECISIONS.md`. Give the four rulings and chapter one can be drafted and gated.
